# awiam

> Who is this caller? A directory and session store that fails honestly.

Deactivation that takes effect "eventually" is not deactivation, and a store that cannot be read reports zero users — which every caller reads as "nobody is authorised" or, worse, as an empty directory to helpfully repopulate.

## Install

```
pip install awiam
```

## Use it in 30 seconds

Deactivate one session and watch it stop working immediately.

## Composes with

- [awbac](https://aitherium.github.io/awbac/) — Role-based access control that fails closed and explains itself.
- [awdit](https://aitherium.github.io/awdit/) — An append-only audit trail whose gaps are DETECTABLE.

## Where it lives

- Repo: https://github.com/Aitherium/awiam
- Docs: https://aitherium.github.io/awiam/
- Manifest (keys + the one-line adoption story): https://aitherium.github.io/awiam/aither-manifest.json

This repository is mirrored from the AitherOS monorepo by `.github/workflows/sync-awiam.yml`; hand edits made here are overwritten on the next sync — change the source instead.

Everything Aitherium, in one file for agents: https://aitherium.com/llms.txt
